form_fields.name: monitor_url
form_fields.label: URL
form_fields.description: 监控的目标网址链接，以检测其可用性和性能
form_fields.guide_short: Nginx stub_status 端点 URL，常见 http://<host>/stub_status 或 /nginx_status；Nginx 必须编译 --with-http_stub_status_module。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Full Nginx stub_status endpoint URL, commonly http://host/stub_status or /nginx_status. Nginx must include the http_stub_status module.

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）
form_fields.guide_short: Telegraf inputs.nginx 采集周期，单位秒，默认 60；过短会高频抓 stub_status。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Telegraf inputs.nginx collection interval in seconds; the default is 60. Short intervals query stub_status frequently.

form_fields.name: nginx_vts
form_fields.label: 虚拟主机流量
form_fields.description: 采集 nginx-module-vts。默认关闭，不改变 Status URL。
form_fields.guide_short: 接入时选择，默认关闭。仅当目标已安装 nginx-module-vts，并暴露 JSON 状态页（常见 http://<host>/vts_status/format/json，响应类型为 application/json）时开启。Tengine 不支持。关闭时子配置只写出 inputs.nginx，Status URL 仍只采 stub_status。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Chosen when the collection task is created, and off by default. Turn on only when nginx-module-vts is installed and exposes a JSON status page, commonly http://host/vts_status/format/json with content type application/json. Tengine is not supported. While off, the child config writes only inputs.nginx and the Status URL still collects only stub_status.
form_fields.description_en: Collect nginx-module-vts. Off by default and does not change the Status URL.

table_columns.name: nginx_vts_url
table_columns.label: VTS URL
table_columns.description: nginx-module-vts 的 JSON 状态页。主机须已安装该模块。Tengine 不支持。
table_columns.description_en: JSON status page of nginx-module-vts. The host must already have the module installed. Tengine is not supported.

rules.message_en: URL must start with http:// or https://
